rules.name: verify-xoga750-fix5-masters-match-old-dev
rules.sql: SELECT d.document_name, d.size_bytes, length(d.document) AS db_bytes, md5(d.document) AS db_md5, d.updated_by, d.updated_timestamp FROM opera.oga_document_repository d WHERE d.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND d.business_application_name = 'WEB XTR' AND d.document_name IN ('XTRFills_Broker_CurrentUser_Master.xlsx','MMVT_MissingDeals_Master.xlsx') ORDER BY d.document_name
